title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer during rapid regional failover edge-case
author: Avery Chen
commits: Fix: prevent duplicate backoff escalation when regional-failover and local-cb trigger simultaneously
Fix: ordering guarantee for queue-threshold snapshot used by SLO enforcer
Test: add unit coverage for regionalFailoverEdgecase and backoff race
Docs: add troubleshooting note to SLO enforcer runbook
description: Context: We observed a production incident where a rapid regional failover (healthy->degraded->failover) triggered both the regional failover logic and a local SLO circuit-breaker backoff simultaneously. Because the enforcer snapshot ordering and escalation path did not deduplicate these events, some customer requests were double-shedded causing a visible error spike and unnecessary client-side fallbacks. This PR is a targeted hotfix to stabilize the SLO enforcer in the edge-case where failover and local circuit-breaker triggers happen within the same enforcement window. Changes: 1) Introduce a stable ordering and idempotency check for escalation events so the enforcer treats a coordinated failover+cb as a single escalation; 2) Move threshold snapshot capture to before decision branching to ensure consistent inputs across code paths; 3) Add hysteresis smoothing to backoff escalation so short flapping does not immediately double the penalty; 4) Add unit and integration tests that reproduce the race; 5) Add a small runbook note in the SLO enforcer README describing symptoms and rollback steps. Testing: Unit tests added (edgecase_failover.rs) that assert no double-backoff when simulated failover+cb events occur within 50ms. Integration test scenario (integration-tests/chaos/failover_scenarios.yml) reproduces the production sequence under load; ran in staging and confirmed error spike avoided and SLOs preserved. CI: initial run showed a flaky e2e healthcheck failing (docker/healthcheck.sh race); fixed by extending wait in healthcheck and re-ran - all checks passed. Rollout plan: small canary deploy to staging followed by progressive rollout to Dedicated and Hosted regions. Hotfix will be deployed via standard hotfix pipeline with a manual approval gate for production. Rollback: revert the merge or adjust the enforcer.hysteresis_ms knob (defaults documented) to zero; tests included to validate rollback surface. Related: SUP-2481 (customer incident), ENG-5021 (follow-up to make enforcer metrics more granular).
review_comments: Marcos Duarte: Found a race in backoff escalation when failover_coordinator triggers concurrently - suggested making event IDs idempotent. See inline comment on backoff.rs:line 78.
Elena Park: Request to add a unit test that covers both code paths and assert single-escalation observed. Also asked to add runbook note for oncall (answered by author).
Samir Kapoor: Verified integration test reproduces issue in staging, approved after CI green. Left a nit about log verbosity which was addressed in the follow-up commit.
Avery Chen (author): Replied to Marcos describing the idempotency key approach and why we use the pre-branch snapshot to maintain consistent semantics. Updated tests and added README note.
ci_checks: e2e/healthcheck: failed (first run) then passed on rerun - root cause: healthcheck race fixed
release_notes: Hotfix: SLO enforcer - stabilize behavior during simultaneous regional failover and local circuit-breaker triggers. Prevents double load-shedding and reduces transient customer errors.
